research_rationale:
EO 11241 (August 26, 1965; Executive Order 11241, Amending the Selective Service Regulations; F.R. Doc. 65-9224) was read in full from the held Federal Register text. It has two operative items, each an amendment of the text of the Selective Service Regulations (Chapter XVI of Title 32 CFR): item 1 amends subparagraph (3) and item 2 amends subparagraph (4) of paragraph (a) of section 1631.7 (Part 1631, Quotas and Calls), and item 3 fixes the effective date of the amended subparagraphs as the date of the order. An order that rewrites regulation text acts once: its own command was performed on its effective date, August 26, 1965, and the text it put in the regulation is a surviving consequence kept separate from the command. That consequence continued until EO 11497 of November 26, 1969 revoked paragraphs (a) and (b) of section 1631.7 and prescribed a new paragraph (a) (34 FR 19019), and the later cleanup order EO 12553 of February 25, 1986 revoked EO 11241 by number. The Office of the Federal Register catalog note lists amendment by EO 11360 (June 30, 1967), EO 11497 (November 26, 1969), EO 11527 (April 23, 1970), EO 11537 (June 16, 1970) and EO 11563 (September 26, 1970), and revocation by EO 12553 (February 25, 1986); the held 1989 codification observation likewise records revocation by EO 12553. Each of the five amending orders was read: EO 11360 amended paragraph (a) of section 1631.7 only by adding an introductory phrase and striking words from its second proviso and prescribed a new paragraph (b); EO 11497 revoked paragraphs (a) and (b); EO 11527 amends other sections (1622 and 1628) and does not mention section 1631.7; EO 11537 and EO 11563 amend or restate section 1631.7 as prescribed by EO 11497, after the revocation of paragraph (a). The status record for EO 11241 is the proposal 'no' filed with this sheet; the U.S. Code and eCFR searches found no hit for this order.

savings.reason: Neither EO 11497 nor EO 12553 contains a saving clause preserving the text of EO 11241. EO 11497's new paragraph (a)(3)(iii) separately provides a subgroup of registrants who married on or before August 26, 1965, as that order's own command, and EO 12553 later revoked EO 11497 together with EO 11241 in the same cleanup list (the held list names Nos. 11241 and 11497). No accrued right or surviving consequence of EO 11241 itself was located after the bounded searches.
